text:
devrel_ana: Hey folks — heads up: Open Forge Weekend (May 16-17) is live! We're running a weekend hackathon for maintainer contributors and community plugin authors. Primary goals: triage community issues, ship small feature PRs, and onboard new maintainers. RSVP and mentor signups here: https://events.redwood.dev/open-forge

chandra_k: Amazing, count me in for mentoring Saturday afternoon. Any preferred tracks?

devrel_ana: Thanks @chandra_k :party_parrot: Tracks: 1) SDK adapters, 2) eval harness tests & prompt sets, 3) infra/plugins for redwoodctl. We'll post issues labelled `good-first-forge` and `mentor-needed`.

sophia_r: Will there be sponsored cloud credits for participants doing heavier jobs (tests, model runs)?

mattj: Yes — we have a small pool of credits and dedicated Dedicated instances for the weekend. Organizers will DM you the details after RSVP.

devrel_ana: Logistics: schedule + runbook is here — https://github.com/redwood-inference/open-forge/blob/main/SCHEDULE.md. Quick clone to get started:
```
git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/open-forge.git
cd open-forge
./scripts/setup-local.sh
```

ops-bot: @channel Event `Open Forge Weekend` created in #workspace-calendar for May 16 09:00 — 17:00 UTC. Event link: https://calendar.redwood.dev/event/OFW-2026

chandra_k: Will we have swag shipping for new maintainers who merge >2 PRs?

devrel_ana: Yup — stickers and a maintainers hoodie. We'll have a short form for shipping addresses post-event.

sophia_r: Also can we include a short “how to run local evals” workshop? New contributors struggle with the eval harness on macOS.

devrel_ana: Great idea — adding a 45m workshop slot Sunday morning focused on macOS / M1 dev setups and docker-less workflows.

mattj: Heads up — we'll also cut a tiny release Friday: `redwood-bridge v0.5.0` with better plugin entrypoints and a migration note. Will post release notes + a `migration.md` in the repo.

devrel_ana: Nice! We'll surface that in the kickoff. If anyone wants to prep onboarding issues or short tasks, please tag them with `for-forge`.

calendar-bot: Reminder set: 48 hours before event -> post in #announcements and ping `@maintainers`.

sophia_r: RSVP'd. Looking forward to it :rocket:

devrel_ana: Thanks all. If you've got volunteers for accessibility testing or localization -- ping me. See you at Open Forge Weekend! :tada:
